summary: Fate Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $100,000,000 of common stock through sales agent Leerink Partners under a sales agreement dated November 5, 2026. Sales occur at market prices; no escrow; Leerink receives up to 3.0% commission. Shares trade on Nasdaq as FATE, last at $1.61 on November 11, 2026. Only 106,155 shares (~$176,812) had been sold under a prior shelf. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; dilution and ATM overhang are the watch items.
